message.content: In the discussion regarding video games, Elara expresses an interest in enjoying various games beyond just action-adventure titles. She mentions that she usually leans towards action and adventure games. However, Elara is open to exploring other genres and shares her thoughts on strategy games, suggesting that she might give them a try in the future. Her preference leans towards games that offer strategic depth and depth in combat, which aligns well with genres such as role-playing games (RPGs) and turn-based strategy games. One of the games she recommends is "XCOM 2," which is described as having "awesome tactical gameplay" and being "really engaging" with "tons of customization options for your squad." This recommendation indicates that Elara enjoys games that provide thoughtful strategic elements and immersive gameplay experiences.
